Resolves #18641

Refs #18605

A `perspectives` value may now be an already-lowered `neo.dock.zone.v1` document as well as `zones`. `PerspectiveSelection#capture()` admits it through the new `Authoring.fromDocument` — the checks a supplied `dockModel` passes, in `fromZones`' result shape, without normalization — and keeps it as the baseline. The baseline is never registered, so a host that supplies its saved document can still declare the arrangement it ships, even while a sibling holds one of that arrangement's panes. A host that supplies nothing starts from a document-valued active declaration directly. This unblocks #18612's declared-baseline slice.

Evidence: L2 (unit tier: real Workspace, WorkspaceSet and Transaction Group in the single-thread runtime, with a cold-hydrate-shaped write) → L2 required (an engine leaf; #18612 carries the rendered Workstation receipt). Residual: none.

Decision Record impact: amends ADR 0029 §2.1 (wording — named `zones` arrangements or already-lowered documents — plus the Status row note).

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `DockPerspectiveDocuments.spec.mjs` — a document-valued perspective is its baseline byte-for-byte with no `panes` catalog; an invalid document fails capture as `perspectives.broken: … document.items …`; a map mixing zones and documents keeps each by kind. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: the same spec's Group-bound arm is #18612's probe at the engine tier. A sibling owns `preview`; the host is supplied the saved main and declares the shipped document; it constructs, and after the cold-hydrate write `dock.perspective` reads `{active: 'shipped', modified: true, pending: null}` while the baseline still holds `preview`. |
| AC-3 | The `Workspace#perspectives` docblock, `capture()`'s JSDoc, the `Authoring` class docblock and ADR 0029 §2.1 carry the wording. |

## Deltas from ticket
- Beyond the Fix section, recorded at claim: `capture()` returns the active declaration's value, and `onAfterConstructed` lowered it a second time when nothing is supplied, so a document-valued active perspective would have failed there. It now becomes the first document directly; the pane catalog still lowers on its own, so `declaredPaneItems` keeps its meaning.
- Checked at intake and left alone: a declaring host that supplies its own document now sets `paneDeclarations` to `{}` rather than `null`. Every consumer treats the two alike — `retainRevealPane` acts only on `=== true`, and an empty catalog answers `false`.
- The discriminator is the `schema` marker. The zones reader itself refuses a `schema` key (`zones.schema: is not part of this node type`), so a zones value cannot be misread as a document.
- Accretion: the engine gains two `Authoring` statics and a branch, and removes no consumer line here. The consumer deletion is #18612's — the Workstation's hand-read `activeLayoutId` capture origin.

## Test Evidence
- RED first: all four new arms failed on unchanged `dev@8cab26fcf8`, each at capture lowering the document as zones (`perspectives.shipped: zones.schema: is not part of this node type; …`).
- Mutation: with only the non-supplying host's adoption removed (`me.dockModel = document`), exactly the byte-for-byte arm fails (`a host that supplies nothing starts from the declared document`); the other three stay green. Reverted; tree clean.
- GREEN: `test/playwright/unit/dashboard/` 1156 passed, 2 skipped. Full unit tier at 413bbfc2da: 3904 passed, 2 skipped.
